title: Payroll Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Payroll Specialist to independently manage end-to-end payroll for 1,000+ employees across India. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in payroll processing, statutory compliance, payroll taxation, reconciliation, statutory filings, maintenance of mandatory registers, and payroll audits.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be capable of owning the complete payroll cycle—from validating employee inputs and attendance data to salary disbursement, statutory remittances, returns, reconciliation, and audit readiness—while ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with applicable Indian labour and payroll regulations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities.
  
  
**End-to-End Payroll Management**

* Own and execute monthly payroll processing for 500+ employees with a strong focus on accuracy and timely closure.
* Validate payroll inputs including new joiners, exits, attendance, leave, LOP, salary revisions, promotions, incentives, bonuses, arrears, reimbursements, deductions and other variable components.
* Calculate monthly earnings and deductions including Basic, HRA, allowances, incentives, overtime, arrears, LOP and recoveries.
* Manage Full & Final (F&F) settlements, leave encashment, notice-period recovery/payments, gratuity and other separation-related payments.
* Perform pre-payroll and post-payroll validations and variance analysis before payroll sign-off.
* Prepare bank advice/payment files and coordinate timely salary disbursement.
* Generate and distribute payslips and other payroll-related employee documents.
* Maintain payroll calendars, checklists and maker-checker controls to ensure timely payroll closure.

**Statutory & Payroll Compliance**

* Ensure payroll complies with applicable Indian labour, employment, social-security and taxation requirements.
* Manage compliance relating to Provident Fund (PF/EPF), ESI, Professional Tax (PT), Labour Welfare Fund (LWF), TDS and other applicable payroll-related statutory requirements.
* Manage PF processes including UAN-related activities, ECR preparation, contribution reconciliation and statutory remittances.
* Manage ESI contributions, employee coverage changes, challans and reconciliations.
* Calculate and deduct Professional Tax based on applicable state requirements.
* Manage LWF deductions and contributions wherever applicable.
* Ensure statutory payments, challans, returns and filings are completed within prescribed timelines.
* Track changes in statutory requirements, wage definitions, contribution limits, tax rules and other payroll-related regulatory changes and implement them appropriately.
* Coordinate with Finance, HR, auditors, consultants and statutory authorities wherever required.

**Income Tax & TDS**

* Manage employee income-tax computation and monthly TDS deductions.
* Validate employee tax declarations and investment proofs.
* Handle tax regime selections and applicable payroll tax calculations.
* Reconcile payroll TDS with Finance records and statutory filings.
* Support quarterly TDS return processes and reconciliation of payroll-related tax data.
* Manage Form 16 preparation, reconciliation and issuance within statutory timelines.
* Handle employee tax queries and corrections relating to payroll taxation.

**Statutory Registers & Documentation**

* Maintain all applicable payroll, wage and statutory registers in the prescribed format, whether electronically or physically as required.
* Ensure maintenance of applicable records/registers relating to wages, deductions, fines, advances, overtime, attendance, leave, bonus and other employment/payroll records.
* Ensure registers and supporting documentation are updated accurately and retained for the prescribed period.
* Maintain employee-wise statutory contribution and deduction records.
* Ensure payroll documentation is readily available for internal audits, statutory inspections, due diligence and external audits.
* Maintain a compliance calendar covering all payroll-related filings, payments, returns and register requirements.

**Payroll Reconciliation & Controls**

* Perform monthly payroll reconciliation against the previous month's payroll and approved HR inputs.
* Reconcile gross salary, net salary, employee count, statutory deductions, employer contributions, TDS and bank payout amounts.
* Reconcile payroll outputs with Finance/General Ledger and resolve differences before closure.
* Maintain clear audit trails for all payroll adjustments and manual interventions.
* Identify payroll discrepancies, investigate root causes and implement corrective and preventive controls.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of duties, access controls and confidentiality of payroll information.

**Audits & Compliance Management**

* Act as the primary payroll point of contact for internal, statutory and external audits.
* Provide payroll registers, challans, returns, reconciliations and supporting documentation during audits and inspections.
* Track audit observations and ensure timely closure of payroll-related findings.
* Conduct periodic payroll compliance checks to identify potential gaps before statutory or internal audits.
* Coordinate with payroll vendors/consultants where applicable while retaining internal ownership of payroll accuracy and compliance.

**Employee Lifecycle & Payroll Support**

* Ensure accurate payroll setup for new employees.
* Process salary revisions, promotions, transfers and other compensation changes.
* Manage employee exits and timely Full & Final settlements.
* Respond to employee queries relating to salary, deductions, PF, ESI, tax, Form 16, F&F and other payroll matters.
* Maintain employee payroll data with a high degree of confidentiality and accuracy.

title: Associate Director, Early Talent

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  
  
Why Syneos Health
  
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.

Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

experiences that can be adapted to local talent markets, regulations and business requirements.

Assess and optimize the existing portfolio, including opportunities to consolidate duplicative campus recruiting, university partnerships and marketing efforts, and evaluate programs that may no longer have the ROI or

strategic fit.

* Build the early talent brand - Create a differentiated proposition and lead year-round campus campaigns, content, pre-placement engagements and build engagement initiatives.

* . Established relationships across leading universities and institutions Globally

* A strong track record in building early talent employer brands and creating campus experiences that improve awareness, engagement and hiring outcomes.
* Strong ability to partner with business leaders and help them establish priorities in the campusspace.
* Strong executive presence, program leadership and analytical capability, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and work effectively across cultures and time zones.

* Travel will be based on need.

**Critical Skills**

* Early Talent Strategy
* Campus Recruiting
* Employer Branding
* Program Development & Governance
* Stakeholder Management

**Get to know Syneos Health**
Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
  
  
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
  
  
http://www.syneoshealth.com

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Associate Director, Early Talent is responsible for establishing and leading the organization's global Early Talent and campus hiring capability.
